name: Skinning Weights Weak Supervision
aliases: Weak Supervision for Gaussian Skinning Weights
definition: Regularization to ensure Gaussian skinning weights generalize by supervising them with SMPL skinning weights based on proximity.
summary: Skinning Weights Weak Supervision regularizes 3D Gaussian skinning weights using ground-truth SMPL data to ensure pose generalization, differing from other methods by focusing on geometric consistency rather than photometric fidelity.
